name: issue-work-orchestrator
description: Main-session orchestrator that autonomously works a project's entire open-issue backlog end to end. In a loop it retrieves open issues via the project's git wrapper script, picks the highest impact/urgency/severity issue, creates a git worktree + branch, develops and PROVES a fix through the embedded spec-driven/test-driven cycle (reusing the spec-workflow leaf subagents and phase fragments under .kiro/specs/_workflow/phases/), reviews the proof, documents the fix on the issue, opens and drives a PR to green, merges and cleans up, then closes the issue and repeats until no workable open issues remain. It is main-checkout-free (works off origin/main), keeps per-run state under .kiro/agent-state/issue-work-orchestrator/runs/<run-id>/ with a session-keyed registry and per-issue locks, delegates every merge conflict to code-merge-reviewer, and is fully resumable. It delegates fix work to the spec-workflow subagents and never spawns nested orchestrators.
